character.name: Santa

Cradling a glowing gold-leaf key while winking. Soft-focus wooden workshop shelf in background with wooden toys and glowing warm fairy lights. Warm amber rim lighting, shallow depth of field, 8k resolution, 9:16 vertical.

prompts.prompt_voice_dialogue: Vocal style: Jolly, deep, heartwarming artisan Santa. 'Ho ho ho! Every heart has a spark of magic—share yours generously this season. Happy Holidays!'
